title: Validate integrated Windows repair and record timing
requires: Physical Windows GTX 1080 with merged F8-73/F8-76/F8-77, retained Windows captures and a clean current-main Release build
scope: Validate the integrated Windows CUDA repair after the Metal/shared-runtime and public completion-wait changes. Apply the maintainer's 2026-11-03 timing deferral in docs/roadmap/PHYSICS-QUALITY-DEVELOPMENT.md. Capture the complete installed-public correctness, work and recovery evidence plus all frozen timing samples. Classify every failure. F9-07 owns the remaining Windows performance optimization and original 10 ms physics p95, 16.666666666666668 ms frame p95 and 0.99 simulated/wall targets. Preserve shared numerical semantics, one 1/60-second advance, one spatial publication and all dispatch/iteration/submission/readback/synchronization budgets. This task produces integrated evidence for F8-74.
acceptance: Build clean current-main Windows Release with the accepted F8-73/F8-76/F8-77 changes. Pass every original registered test and ownership/completion regression with no required skip, affected portable/reference checks and relocated SDK checks. Investigate any new correctness, lifetime or recovery failure.

Complete all 30 installed public cases and all 12 physical scenarios in both plain and validation modes. Physical-quality, numerical, capability, independent solver-work and rejected-step recovery checks must pass. Identify every remaining failure by assertion and evidence.

Run all five desktop workloads in both modes at exact frozen live/capacity counts with 600 warmup and 7200 measured ticks and zero failed ticks. Retain every sample, stall and required completion wait. Report CPU, native GPU, physics/frame p50/p95/p99 and simulated/wall ratio against the original targets. Timing-only misses are accepted as disclosed F9-07 follow-up debt.

Run and retain all five canonical negative controls in both modes. Distinguish expected rejection of each injected defect from unrelated baseline timing failures. A timing-failed unmodified baseline leaves that canonical control unqualified for final performance acceptance. Demonstrate affected correctness/work/recovery rejection independently and route timing-dependent qualification to F9-07/F9-08.

Verify one 1/60-second advance, one spatial publication, atomic rejected-step recovery and every independent dispatch/iteration/submission/readback/synchronization budget. Preserve numerical fixtures, goldens, required timeouts, workload sizes and advertised capabilities.

Publish exact source/tree, compiler/device/memory attributes, installed driver/SDK/manifest hashes, raw evidence and protected-closure classification. Compare retained before/after measurements with source differences identified. F8-74 requires this integrated correctness evidence. Record the timing deferral explicitly while preserving candidate-v9 failure history.
evidence: PASS: clean Release source 5bacbe2b1e0fbfad565fb9477bb6873396e31d5d on Windows GTX 1080, all 146 registered tests with zero skips and every previous test retained, plus 12 relocated-SDK checks. docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-78-WINDOWS-INTEGRATION.json records exact source/tree, device, compiler, memory attributes and all binary/SDK hashes.

PASS: all 30 public cases and 12 physical scenarios per mode, frozen physical/capability/work/recovery assertions, five unchanged workloads per mode with 600 warmup and 7200 measured ticks. All 72000 measured ticks succeed. All 288000 raw timing values retained and percentile/max summaries recomputed. All five injected defects independently rejected in each mode.

DISCLOSED: plain/validation six-family physics p95 18.5305/20.6715 ms and simulated/wall ratio 0.989253/0.837211; validation deformable physics p95 11.1551 ms. Original suite retains 8/9 failures, comprising 3/4 timing misses plus five timing-contaminated canonical controls. PR 657 defers this performance qualification to F9-07/F9-08. Candidate refreeze and scene-quality work remain pending.
